task.description:
Run the PD-04 test suite and produce a structured test report.

**Commands to run:**
```
zig build test
zig build test-integration  (requires BPM_TEST_DB_URL)
```

If `BPM_TEST_DB_URL` is not set, run only the unit test suite (`zig build test`) and note the integration test skip in the report.

Write the test report to `tests/reports/PD-04-test-report.json` following the format in `docs/guides/test_developer_guide.md §8`.

If any tests fail:
- Set `result.status = "FAIL"`
- Include every failing test case in `result.issues` with severity and description
- Route back to ISSUE-FIXER

If all tests pass:
- Set `result.status = "PASS"`
- Set `result.next_action = "Route to RELEASE-VALIDATOR"`
acceptance_criteria: All PD-04 integration tests pass (or integration skip is documented with reason)
All TC-PD-04-01 through TC-PD-04-11 test cases have a PASS result
